hook.say: Fifty states, five questions, three seconds each. The last one trips up plenty of Americans!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which state is home to the Grand Canyon?
questions.fact: The canyon is 277 miles long and more than a mile deep.
questions.sayAnswer: Arizona! The canyon is 277 miles long, and more than a mile deep.

questions.q: Which is the smallest US state by area?
questions.say: Which is the smallest U.S. state by area?
questions.fact: Rhode Island would fit inside Alaska more than 400 times.
questions.sayAnswer: Rhode Island! It would fit inside Alaska more than 400 times.

questions.q: What is the capital of California?
questions.fact: Sacramento was chosen as California's capital back in 1854.
questions.sayAnswer: Sacramento! It was chosen as California's capital back in 1854.

questions.q: Which US state has the longest coastline?
questions.say: Which U.S. state has the longest coastline?
questions.fact: Alaska has about 6,640 miles of coast. Florida is second with 1,350.
questions.sayAnswer: Alaska! It has about 6,640 miles of coast. Florida is second, with 1,350.

questions.q: Which is the only state that borders exactly one other state?
questions.fact: Maine touches only New Hampshire. Its other neighbor is Canada.
questions.sayAnswer: Maine! It touches only New Hampshire. Its other neighbor is Canada.
